AfroBot USA

01

The pilot

AfroBot USA started in McKinney, Texas, in 2024. About 30 students took part. Five to six teams built solutions together, and parents worked closely with them.

02

Teams building together

The teams shared tables and built side by side. This clip and photo are from that day.

03

Families in the room

Parents were in the work with the teams. This is the Build Day group.

04

What we learned

It was a very exciting, magical, beautiful experience. Kids and parents built something together in one room in Texas.

05

What's next

The first season is an 8-team pilot. Teams are about 8 students plus coaches. Ages stay on Programs. Dallas–Fort Worth and Yaoundé stay on Competitions.
